review_scope: development-only open-textbook expansion; no train/validation/test assignment and no model use
method: Verified title, named authors, publisher, revision and document URL against all 10 pinned API content records.
Verified CC BY 4.0 against a separately pinned edition or project metadata record for every work.
Reviewed rendered openings, endings, structure and recorded exclusions for all 10 documents.
Searched every rendered file for HTML markup and Unicode replacement characters, then reviewed all 45 document comparisons and all threshold matches among 766 screened cross-document paragraphs.

editorial_notes: Headings, prose, lists, code and tables are retained as NFC plain text.
Figures with captions, standalone images, media embeds, Pressbooks footnotes and recognized trailing reference sections are excluded.
Raw content and license JSON records remain available in the immutable local snapshot, each pinned by SHA-256.
source_limitations: Eight of ten records come from one Pressbooks host, and institutional open textbooks dominate the wave.
Only three publisher identities and English-language works are represented.
Document length is imbalanced, and the lexical duplicate screen cannot establish absence of paraphrased or semantic overlap.

decision: Accept as a development-only third expansion wave. Preserve 10 separate work/author groups, exclude every inspected work from the future untouched test, and continue acquisition across unrelated publishers and genres before freezing splits.
